item.title: 'Femstodes' Controversy Sees Resurgence Online After GW Reveals Official Female Custodes Minis
item.description: Warhammer Female Custodes Controversy, also known as the Warhammer 40K Femstodes Debate, refers to Games Workshop, the creators of the Warhammer 40,000 franchise, confirming in the 10th Edition Codex that there are female members of the Adeptus Custodes faction, which was previously presumed to be an all-male cadre of warriors within the lore and setting. The revelation was then confirmed on the official Twitter / X account for Warhammer Official (@warhammer) in mid-April 2024 and led to outrage

item.title: Places That Are Inarguably Much Cooler Than Japan Hyped Up In New Text Graphic Meme Format
item.description: Why Does Everyone Want To Go To Japan is an exploitable text post meme using the phrasal template, "Why does everyone want to go to Japan, let's go to X," "X" being a place that is ironically better than Japan. The meme was originally posted to Instagram in mid-January 2026 and spread to X that month, inspiring edits.

item.title: It's Been 12 Years Since 'The Babadook' Gave Us The 'Why Can't You Just Be Normal' Meme
item.description: Why Can’t You Just Be Normal? refers to a scene from The Babadook in which the main character turns to her son in her car and cries “Why can’t you just be normal?” The child responds by shrieking. The scene became an exploitable where the characters are labeled as different objects.

item.title: What Is The 'City Boy' Meme? The 'Gravity Falls' Clip And 2026 Resurgence Explained
item.description: The "City Boy" meme is making a familiar return across social media, with users once again shouting "City Boy! City Boy!" in reaction videos and edits. The format traces back to a scene from Gravity Falls, where Deputy Durland repeatedly mocks Dipper by yelling the phrase to frame him as out of place.

item.title: Seven Years Ago, Tumblr's 'Color Theory Children's Hospital' Post Became An All Time Classic
item.description: Tumblr Color Theory Children's Hospital Post is a viral reblog thread on Tumblr where a user claims that red, painted pathways on a hospital floor do not necessarily look like blood because, in color theory, red has more positive than negative connotations. The post was made in January 2019 and gained viral spread that year, inspiring memes where red painted and bloody floors are referenced as children's hospital floors.
